qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Pioneering telematics data advantage (Snapshot) and unmatched actuarial segmentation allow Progressive to price risk more granularly than peers, creating a self-reinforcing scale-economies-shared flywheel. Competitors cannot easily match its proprietary telematics loss ratio advantage (10-15% lower loss ratios) or rapid automated rate filings across 50 states. Primary erosion threats include gradual adoption of OEM embedded telematics, broader commoditization of telematics software, and long-term reduction in collision frequency from advanced autonomous driving systems (ADAS).
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Premier US personal and commercial auto insurer operating on a scale-economies-shared engine, utilizing industry-leading Snapshot telematics algorithms to segment risk and consistently deliver a sub-96 combined ratio (87.4% in 2025). Superior pricing agility enabled rapid rate repricing ahead of post-COVID inflation, taking massive market share while peers retrenched. Resilient across all 5 macrotrends with rising investment income from higher yields and insulated US domestic profile. Exceptional fortress balance sheet with >50x interest coverage and generous variable dividend distributions. [5-10Y g: policy-in-force volume 5.5% + rate segmentation/price 2.5% + commercial lines expansion 1.0% - combined ratio normalization drag 1.5% + capital return 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 23.0% and tangible ROIC of 23.3%, with 2024-2025 ROIC surging above 38-41%. Total policies in force expanded 18% in 2024 to 34.95M and another 10% in 2025 to 38.62M. Underwriting excellence demonstrated by calendar 2024 combined ratio of 88.2% and 2025 combined ratio of 87.4%, dramatically beating the company's 96.0% target. Peak Owner EPS reached $19.23 in 2025, eclipsing the prior 2020 peak of $9.89. FCF conversion exceeds 150% (2025 Owner FCF of $17.1B vs Net Income of $11.3B). Balance sheet carries >50x interest coverage ($14.5B EBIT vs $278M interest expense) and zero net debt burden, supporting large variable dividend distributions ($13.50/share for 2024 performance).
